changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment:
Sequence backing hospital identifiers (HMS-YYYY-NNNN and UNK-YYYY-NNNN).
Deliberately NOT the entity sequence_generator: that one has incrementBy 50 for HiLo-style allocation, so identifiers shown to patients and printed on records would visibly jump (1050, 1100, 1150...). A separate dense series is both tidier and safer.
A sequence rather than max(hospital_id)+1 because hospital_id is a unique column and two concurrent registrations would otherwise be handed the same value, failing the second save with a constraint violation.

changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment: Functional index matching the normalisation in PatientRepository.findByIdentityDocumentNormalized. Without it, the exact identity-document duplicate check is a sequential scan on the patient table. Partial, because nulls never need matching.
